# SpendSathi

> SpendSathi is a privacy-first Android expense tracker and budget manager built for Indian users. It automatically parses bank, credit card, and UPI SMS alerts entirely on-device—never uploading financial or SMS data to any SpendSathi server.

## Product Overview
- **Target Audience:** Android users in India tracking UPI, bank account, and credit card spending
- **Platform:** Android 8.0+ Only (No iOS) — Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.finmate.app
- **Developer:** Mohit Kumar Varma (Hyderabad, India) — `mohi.varma18@gmail.com`
- **Pricing:** `₹0` Free Forever (ad-supported via Google AdMob) + `₹149` one-time Ad-Free Pro upgrade
- **Privacy Architecture:** Financial & SMS data is 100% stored and processed locally on-device (never uploaded to any SpendSathi server; ignores OTPs and personal chats). Free tier uses Google AdMob and Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics for ad delivery and app stability.

## Core Features
- **Automatic Bank & UPI SMS Parsing:** Reads debit, credit, UPI, and card alerts locally on Android across major Indian banks (HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, Yes Bank, etc.) and UPI apps, while completely ignoring OTPs and personal chats.
- **Spend Score & Safe Daily Spend:** Real-time financial pacing score (0–100) and daily safe-to-spend limit based on remaining monthly budget and days left in the month.
- **Separate SIP & Investment Tracking:** Automatically excludes SIPs, Mutual Funds, and stocks from everyday living expenses so dashboards and budgets stay accurate.
- **Manual Local Backup & Restore + PDF Reports:** Export JSON/CSV backups locally and generate clean monthly PDF financial statements directly on your phone.
